tool_args.rationale: The hydraulic source note suggests a gradient-dependent sink plus an unspecified branch term. A targeted open-branch probe can distinguish that contribution before fitting and confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the hydraulic basin siphon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows do not identify the branch term independently of the base field.
The pilot varies substrate and gradient together, leaving these alternatives insufficiently discriminated.
The open-branch probe more directly addresses the current ambiguity at lower cost.
